showcase.criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW AWG with measured insertion loss
showcase.rationale: CUMEC 16 x 16 Si AWG, 0.98 dB central-channel IL, adjacent crosstalk > 22.7 dB, 2 um arrayed waveguides, 550 x 590 um2; number of arms not reported (template drawn schematically)

showcase.criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW directional coupler with measured performance and a drawable gap and coupling length
showcase.rationale: CSEM TFLN MPW run, gap 660 nm, coupling length 34.5 um, 600 nm wide in the coupling region, 600 nm film / 400 nm etch; measured split 12:88 (bar:cross); excess loss not reported. Only dc-template component with both required dimensions

showcase.criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db per_facet among edge couplers reporting tip_width_nm (tapered couplers; untapered glass / polymer butt facets excluded)

showcase.criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db per_facet among edge couplers reporting tip_width_nm (tapered couplers; untapered glass / polymer butt facets excluded)

showcase.criterion: foundry platform edge coupler with measured loss ( typical)

showcase.criterion: foundry PDK edge coupler with measured loss ( typical)

showcase.criterion: lowest per-coupler loss from a measurement (per_coupler or loopback_half) among gc_1d components reporting period_nm

showcase.criterion: lowest per-coupler loss from a measurement (per_coupler or loopback_half) among gc_1d components reporting period_nm

components.core_material: Si slab 340 nm (end-fire coupled, same device layer as the SiN waveguide), 3 um SiO2 above / 2 um below; target doping p 2e17 cm-3, n+ 1e19 cm-3, p++ / n++ contacts 1e20 cm-3 3 um apart; lateral junction, intrinsic width w = 0 um, displacement 0 um from the waveguide center
components.notes: Device ID 01 of Table S1 (p.11), one of 16 lateral doping variants (only the 16 um long lateral devices were characterized, p.4). Input via lensed-fiber inverse-taper edge coupler (cmp_lit_alexander2026_edge_coupler), SiN waveguide and Si-SiN end-fire interface (cmp_lit_alexander2026_si_sin_endfire). Fabricated on 8-inch wafers at the commercial foundry Advanced Micro Foundry on a SiN-on-SOI platform (p.4 Sec. III). PDE and DCR at the headline operating point (Pin 500 pW, Vex 1.5 V) read off Fig. S3 / Fig. 4 (device IDs 01-08 agree between Fig. 4, Fig. S3 and Table S1); the Vex 0.5 / 1.0 V bars of Fig. S3 not entered. Family-level statements not entered (device identity not stated): DCR on the order of 1e7 cps and PDE ~1 % across variants (p.4), lateral linear-mode photocurrent ~100 uA at 1 mW (~0.5 A/W) 'with a few exceptions' (p.5), afterpulsing 25-30 % overall / 1.5-2.2 % largest peak, ~2.2 ns peak interval, ~15 / ~18 ns decay for 'a typical SPAD' (p.9 Supp. SIII).

components.label: GaAs nano-ridge FP laser diode on 300 mm Si, two etched facets, 1 mm (wafer level)
components.core_material: GaAs nano-ridge by MOVPE selective-area growth with aspect-ratio trapping from V-shaped STI trenches on 300 mm (001) Si: n-GaAs, 3 x In0.2Ga0.8As QWs in uid GaAs, p-GaAs, InGaP passivation cap; W-plug p-contacts at 4.8 um pitch, Cu damascene BEOL
components.notes: Grown and fabricated in imec's 300 mm CMOS pilot line by the authors (contributions p.21: NR growth executed and wafer fabrication coordinated by authors; acknowledgement p.21): fab_org_ids org_imec. Platform iii_v_on_si_epi (monolithic epitaxy on Si; OFC W2A.10 nano-ridge precedent used gaas). Laser wavelength ~1020 nm (nir_below_o). Wafer-scale statistics: more than 300 functional lasers over three lengths, 87 of them 1 mm long (Fig. 5(a) panel label, p.29); total two-facet power and slope from on-wafer NR photodiode photocurrent using the cited PD responsivity 0.65 A/W [48] and a simulated 12.5 % LD-to-PD coupling (p.6, p.20 Methods): those values are author_estimate; thresholds come directly from the I-I curves (measured). Etched facets: 12 deg, ~1000 nm deep (HAADF-STEM, Supp. S1), ~5 % reflectivity (simulated); facet angle convention ambiguous, not entered. minimum threshold 4.5 mA = 1.2 kA/cm2 (p.6).

components.label: Coaxial dual-core fiber fan-in (45 deg reflective fiber prism + V-groove), CDCF with circular central core
components.core_material: CDCF: central core radius 6 um, annular core 42.5-47.5 um radius, cladding radius 62.5 um; core RI 1.4602, cladding 1.4572 at 633 nm (p.3, Fig. 1(a)-(c)); 980 nm SMF inputs
components.notes: Cold-processed fan-in on a quartz substrate with two orthogonal V-grooves and a quartz cover plate (UV-cured adhesive): the CDCF central core (CC) is butt-coupled to a first single-core fiber whose end is polished into a symmetric 45 deg truncated pyramid with metal-coated (high-reflectivity) facets; two cleaved 980 nm SMFs in the orthogonal groove inject light via the 45 deg facets into the annular core (AC) (p.5 Sec. 3, Fig. 2; p.7 Sec. 4). No fusion splicing or heating. Packaged in a 3D-printed frame with detachable connectors (Fig. 7(d)). Insertion loss per port measured at 980 nm with an ASE source (p.9); measurement reference plane not described. Paper-level averages (AC 2.15 dB, CC 1.25 dB, p.1 / p.9) and bounds (AC < 2.48 dB, CC < 1.45 dB, p.9) span both devices and do not reproduce from Tables 1-2, not entered. Simulated BPM field evolution (980 nm, 9 um MFD input) and facet-angle deviation study (43 / 47 deg) have no numeric loss. Affiliations not printed in the text; fab_org_ids empty.

components.label: Ce:YIG-bonded Si MZI TE optical circulator, broadband (Delta L0 = 1 um), centered 1560 nm
components.core_material: Si 220 nm x 600 nm (248 nm DUV lithography, Bosch etch) under bonded Ce:YIG 400 nm on (Ca,Mg,Zr)-substituted GGG (O2-plasma bonding, 200 C / 6 h / 3 MPa; ~10 nm interfacial oxide assumed in design), GGG lapped to 2 or 8 um; Ti/Au 22/500 nm electromagnets
components.cladding: Ce:YIG / thinned GGG over the circuit, protective sputtered silica
components.notes: Fabrication described passively (p.6-7 Sec. III-A); authors at UCSB, Morton Photonics and Tokyo Institute of Technology, no fabricator or facility named: fab / facility empty. Same building blocks as the 10.7 nm FSR device with a 1 um arm-length difference (larger FSR, p.8). Four-port push-pull MZI TE circulator: adiabatic 50/50 couplers, TE-TM polarization rotators at all ports, TM-NRPS Ce:YIG/Si arms driven by integrated electromagnets (push-pull currents). Two electromagnet layouts on identical passive MZIs: 3-loop coil (L1 1450 / L2 1520 um, single source) and 1-microstrip pair (L1 = L2 = 1020 um, Delta L0 70 um). Drive needed for the pi NRPS (5.35 nm shift): 50 mA with 1-microstrip on 8 um GGG, ~50% lower current and 1/4 power on 2 um GGG, 10 mA (~30 ohm, 3 mW) with the 3-loop coil (p.8, Fig. 11); no nonreciprocal drive-power parameter (gap). Loss breakdown (p.9): IL = 2 x 0.6 dB facets (cited [36]) + 2 x 2.0 dB rotators + 2 x 2.2 dB couplers + 6.4 dB arm, about 16 dB; 6.0 dB projected with a redesign (not entered). Isolation lower than the small-FSR device because of incomplete TE-TM conversion away from the rotator optimum (p.8).

components.label: IRIS wavelength-selective switch matrix (4 network x 8 local ports, 12 x 200 GHz, 48x16 double-MRR switch elements), PIC 3D-stacked with control EIC, fiber-pigtailed package
components.core_material: Si 220 nm on 2 um BOX (8-inch SOI), DUV 193 nm lithography and RIE; Ti/TiN heaters, epitaxial Ge monitor PDs
components.notes: 1398 photonic circuit elements on a 65 mm2 PIC: SPGCs, 12 interleavers, 6-channel AWG mux / demux, 384 double-MRR switch nodes (768 heater cells), crossings, monitor PDs; TE only. EIC in STMicroelectronics BCD8sp 0.16 um (CMOS part) flip-chip on the PIC with 50 um pitch Cu pillars (< 1 ohm per contact); PWM heater drive. Calibration via on-chip PDs and a GBNM routine (LUT of 793 values, about 12 h). < 3 % of components not working. 25 Gb/s BER: about 1 dB penalty single channel, < 0.5 dB with three co-channel interferers (BER floor near 1e-10). Wafer-level spread: central AWG channel > 5 nm inter-die, MRR resonance up to 9 nm (Fig. 5), MRR channels within +/-75 GHz of nominal intra-die (Fig. 6). PIC 'fabricated in the CEA LETI facilities' (p.3 Sec. II): fab CEA-Leti. EIC fabricated in STMicroelectronics' BCD8sp technology (p.4 Sec. III). Packaging (PIC+EIC flip-chip sub-assembly on TEC, wire bonding, fiber-array pigtailing) 'carried out by Technische Universitat Wien and the Universitat Politecnica de Valencia' (p.6 Sec. IV): UPV entered; TU Wien missing from the registry (reported).
